snippet.title: Train Hero - Railoroads Action Puzzle gameplay trailer.
snippet.description:
Google play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gameaki.trainherogame
App store: https://apps.apple.com/gr/app/trains-puzzle-railroads-game/id6748875415
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495070/Train_Hero/
Train Hero is a train railway action puzzle game with a retro feel. It’s easy to play but hard to master and you only need one click to play. 
Conduct trains, switch tracks and use your brain to avoid collisions and to make sure all trains arrive in time at their stations.
As you progress in increasingly challenging levels, you unlock access to powerups and new beautiful worlds.
There are many regions to explore, with different skins and more than 120 levels to play.
